text: **dsh-aux-degrade**（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：调整压缩摘要、会话标题等辅助模型调用，减少高推理档位占用输出预算导致的内容截断。它在 `llm/stream` 瀑布中识别辅助调用并按配置降低 reasoning effort；压缩时还可提高 maxTokens 下界、补充摘要保真要求并清空工具列表。客户端显示官方补丁状态提醒，并提供补丁库链接与忽略提醒设置。适合希望改善 DSH 辅助调用与压缩摘要完整性的用户。需要 DSH 1.5；代码未配置 API key。

**dsh-aux-degrade** (DSH web plugin) tunes auxiliary calls such as summaries and session titles. Its `llm/stream` hook lowers reasoning effort; compaction can get a higher token floor, preservation instructions, and cleared tools. The client shows patch status. Requires DSH 1.5; no API key.
想让 DSH 压缩摘要时少花输出额度在推理上，并尽量保留关键信息。
DSH 自动生成的会话标题经常太短，能不能优化辅助模型调用？
Can I keep compaction calls from wasting their output budget on reasoning and tools?
**dsh-aux-degrade** 的功能「辅助调用降档」：在 `llm/stream` 处理匹配的压缩、标题或来源插件调用；调用方未指定推理档位时，按配置降低 reasoning effort，默认目标为 `off`。
**dsh-aux-degrade** 的功能「压缩请求补强」：遇到 compaction 调用时提高过低的 maxTokens 下界、向摘要指令追加保真章节，并清空工具列表，帮助压缩输出保留约束与命令结果。
dsh-aux-degrade 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 28 天；提交数 13；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-aux-degrade README · dsh-aux-degrade：**Compaction summaries and session titles stop burning their output budget on reasoning.**

> ⚠️ **DSH 1.5 only** (`>=0.1.5-rc.2 <0.2.0`). Newer DSH releases will be supported in follow-up updates.

> 🟢 **Collision risk: very low.** It occupies **one server-side seam (`llm/stream`) and no client slot** — only **4** plugins here share that seam, and it touches **auxiliary calls only** (compaction summaries, session titles), never the main conversation request. See [Compatibility](#compatibility).
dsh-aux-degrade README · dsh-aux-degrade：[](LICENSE) [](#compatibility) [](#compatibility) **English** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) ---

dsh-aux-degrade README · What this is：Besides the main conversation, a DSH session has a pile of **auxiliary LLM calls** running behind the scenes: generating compaction summaries, starting session titles, enhancing prompts.

dsh-aux-degrade README · What this is：They share the same model as the main conversation, yet often **specify no reasoning effort** — so they inherit the high level you set and burn the entire output budget on reasoning. The result is that a compaction summary is cut off halfway by `max_tokens`, and that truncation is **silent**: nothing reports an error, the next turn simply starts with a piece of context missing. A session title that tops out halfway and turns into half a word is the same disease.

dsh-aux-degrade README · What this is：`dsh-aux-degrade` hooks into the `llm/stream` waterfall and scales the auxiliary call down before it is sent.

---

dsh-aux-degrade README · The four things it does：All four happen inside the same `llm/stream` hook. **Note: only #1 is controlled by the `enabled` switch**; #2–#4 execute under any configuration — this is deliberate, because they fix problems like "an upstream plugin omitted required information", not optional optimizations.

dsh-aux-degrade README · 1. Lower the reasoning effort to `off`：If any one of the following conditions holds, this call's `reasoningEffort` is overridden to `off`:

| Criterion | Description |
|---|---|
| **By purpose** | `purpose` falls in the `purposes` list (by default covering `compaction`, `session-title`, `title`) |
| **By originating plugin** | the initiator is in the `auxPlugins` list (by default recognizing `dsh-prompt-enhance`) |
| **By shape** | `purpose` is not declared and `tools` is not an array — a call of this shape is auxiliary |

dsh-aux-degrade README · 1. Lower the reasoning effort to `off`：**And** the caller itself has not explicitly specified `reasoningEffort`. If it set a level itself, this plugin lets it through and does not override someone else's explicit intent.

To use a different level instead of `off`: `config.effort = 'low'` and the like.

dsh-aux-degrade README · 2. Raise `maxTokens` to no less than 1024：Some callers set `maxTokens` extremely small (worst case 1) together with a high reasoning level, which amounts to "truncated before the body even starts".

This plugin gives it a floor: **no less than 1024**. It can be overridden with an environment variable:

```bash
DSH_AUX_MAXTOKENS_FLOOR=2048    # use a different floor
DSH_AUX_MAXTOKENS_FLOOR=0       # turn this item off
```

dsh-aux-degrade README · 3. Append two faithful-preservation requirements to the compaction instruction：The biggest risk of a compaction summary is not "short", it is "lossy". Under pressure a summary generator prioritizes narrative and drops hard facts: paths, commands, error codes, constraints.

Whenever this call has `purpose === 'compaction'`, the plugin appends two sections to the end of the compaction instruction:

```markdown
section: 3. Append two faithful-preservation requirements to the compaction instruction

text:
dsh-aux-degrade README · Commands & outcomes (MUST keep verbatim)：```

**Idempotent**: if the instruction already contains these two sections, they are not appended again.

dsh-aux-degrade README · 4. Clear `tools` on compaction calls：A compaction summary does not need to call any tool. Keeping the tool definitions both consumes prompt space and gives the model the opportunity to "just call a tool while it is at it" — which turns what should be a plain-text summary generation into multiple round trips.

For calls with `purpose === 'compaction'`, `tools` is cleared. It can be turned off with `config.noTools = false`.

dsh-aux-degrade README · Logging：Whenever any of #2–#4 acts, one line is printed:

```
[aux-degrade/context] maxTokens下界=1024 压缩去tools=true 补两节=true
```

The official-patch notice: one dialog, naming the patch and how to apply it：The one official patch this plugin **requires** (`pi-ai-max-tokens-floor`, editing `dist/api/simple-options.js` inside `@earendil-works/pi-ai`) is announced by **this plugin itself**, in one dialog.
section: 9. The official-patch notice: one dialog, naming the patch and how to apply it

text: dsh-aux-degrade README · 9. The official-patch notice: one dialog, naming the patch and how to apply it：Why it is required: upstream pi-ai clamps `max_tokens` to 1, so auxiliary calls (compaction summaries, session titles) can come back with one or two characters — and whatever the summary never covered really does disappear from the context. This plugin can turn the high thinking level off and raise the floor from the plugin layer, but **it cannot change that clamp** (the third-party dist exposes a read-only ESM namespace).

dsh-aux-degrade README · Configuration：The configuration file is the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: aux-degrade
  config:
    enabled: true
    purposes: []

dsh-aux-degrade README · Configuration：| Key | Type | Code default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | **`false`** | Controls only #1 (lowering reasoning effort). It takes effect only when set to `true` — what this repository's `cordis.patch.yml` sets is `true` |
| `purposes` | string[] | `[]` → `['compaction', 'session-title', 'title']` | Identify auxiliary calls by purpose |
| `auxPlugins` | string[] | `[]` → `['dsh-prompt-enhance']` | Identify auxiliary calls by originating plugin. Passing `['__none__']` disables this criterion entirely |
| `models` | string[] | `[]` (unrestricted) | Apply only to the specified models |
| `effort` | string | `'off'` | The level to lower to |
| `noTools` | boolean | `true` | Whether compaction calls have `tools` cleared (#4) |

dsh-aux-degrade README · Configuration：> ⚠️ **`enabled: false` does not mean "zero side effects".** The old documentation said so, and it is wrong. `enabled` only stops #1 (lowering reasoning effort); #2–#4 (raising the `maxTokens` floor, appending the two faithful-preservation requirements, clearing `tools` for compaction) run **before** any `enabled` check in the code, and execute as soon as the `purpose` conditions are met. To stop #2, use `DSH_AUX_MAXTOKENS_FLOOR=0`; for #4 use `config.noTools = false`; #3 (appending the two sections) has no separate switch.

dsh-aux-degrade README · Why is `dsh-prompt-enhance` recognized by default?：Because when it initiates a call it **does not pass `purpose`** — the "by purpose" criterion above is completely ineffective for it. Without this `auxPlugins` criterion, its calls would inherit the high reasoning level all the way through, the output budget would be eaten by inference, and the symptom would be a flood of 502s and half responses. This criterion exists for its sake.

So "calls that get degraded" is a subset of "aux-routed calls" — **degrading is more conservative than routing**, and that is deliberate.

dsh-aux-degrade README · 🔗 With `dsh-context-reclaim` (the context governance pair) — install both together：**② How they divide the work.** aux-degrade handles **calls** (how much reasoning budget this call spends, what the output floor is, whether the compaction instruction needs the faithful-preservation requirements); reclaim handles **content** (purification and bounding of tool results before they enter history, tool definition surface folding, prefix stabilization).

**③ What happens without the other.**

|---|---|
| Only aux-degrade | Everything works as usual. Auxiliary calls are saved and compaction summaries are not truncated. But tool results are not purified or bounded, and long results enter history unchanged |
| Only reclaim | Everything works as usual. But auxiliary calls still burn the full reasoning budget and compaction summaries can still be silently truncated — reclaim will only print `[reclaim/summary-audit] ⚠️ 摘要缺 N/8 段` in the log to remind you, **it will not modify the summary itself** |

dsh-aux-degrade README · FAQ：
Will it lower the reasoning effort of the main conversation too? No. All the criteria point at "auxiliary calls": either the purpose is in the list, or the originating plugin is in the list, or the call declares no `purpose` at all and has no tools. A main-conversation call touches none of the three. And **if the caller explicitly set `reasoningEffort` itself, this plugin always lets it through** — it does not override anyone's explicit intent.

dsh-aux-degrade README · FAQ：
Does `enabled: false` turn it off completely?

dsh-aux-degrade README · FAQ：No. `enabled` controls only #1 (lowering reasoning effort). #2–#4 execute under any configuration. This is not a bug — those three fix problems like "an upstream plugin omitted required information", and switching them off would let the upstream keep failing. If you really want to turn items off one by one: `DSH_AUX_MAXTOKENS_FLOOR=0` turns off #2, `noTools: false` turns off #4, and #3 has no separate switch.
</details>

dsh-aux-degrade README · FAQ：
Why does it recognize `dsh-prompt-enhance` by default? Because it does not pass `purpose` when it initiates a call, so the purpose criterion alone cannot identify it. And it happens to be the plugin hit hardest by this problem — if it is not recognized, it inherits the high reasoning level, the output budget is eaten by inference, and the symptom is a flood of 502s and half responses.

dsh-aux-degrade README · FAQ：
Do I need to restart after installing? Yes. Host-side plugins are loaded when DSH starts.
Does it support web DSH? Yes. This plugin only hooks Cordis's `llm/stream` waterfall seam and does not depend on Electron or any desktop-only capability. **As long as it is DSH, both desktop and web work.**

dsh-aux-degrade README · 这是什么：DSH 会话里除了主对话，还有一堆**辅助 LLM 调用**在背后跑：生成压缩摘要、起会话标题、给提示词增强。

它们和主对话共用同一个模型，却往往**没有指定思考强度**——于是继承你设的高档位，把整个输出预算烧在推理上。结果是压缩摘要写到一半被 `max_tokens` 截断，而截断是**静默**的：你不报错，只是下一轮开始上下文缺了一块。会话标题顶到一半变成半个词，也是同一个病。

`dsh-aux-degrade` 挂在 `llm/stream` 瀑布上，在辅助调用发出去之前把它改小。

---
dsh-aux-degrade README · 它做的四件事：四件事都发生在同一个 `llm/stream` 钩子里。**注意：只有第 1 件受 `enabled` 开关控制**，第 2–4 件在任何配置下都会执行——这是有意的，它们修的是「上游插件省略了必填信息」这类问题，不是可选的优化。

dsh-aux-degrade README · 1. 把思考强度降到 `off`：满足下列条件之一，就把这次调用的 `reasoningEffort` 盖成 `off`：

| 判据 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **按用途** | `purpose` 落在 `purposes` 列表里（默认覆盖 `compaction`、`session-title`、`title`） |
| **按来源插件** | 发起方在 `auxPlugins` 列表里（默认识别 `dsh-prompt-enhance`） |
| **按形状** | `purpose` 未声明、且 `tools` 不是数组——这种调用形状上就是辅助调用 |

**且**调用方自己没有显式指定过 `reasoningEffort`。如果它自己设了档位，本插件放行，不覆盖别人的明确意图。

想换成别的档位而不是 `off`：`config.effort = 'low'` 之类。

dsh-aux-degrade README · 2. 把 `maxTokens` 抬到不低于 1024：有些调用方把 `maxTokens` 设得极小（最坏情况是 1），配上一个高思考档位，等于「还没开始写正文就被截断」。

本插件给它一个下界：**不低于 1024**。可用环境变量覆盖：

```bash
DSH_AUX_MAXTOKENS_FLOOR=2048    # 换个下界
DSH_AUX_MAXTOKENS_FLOOR=0       # 关掉这一项
```

dsh-aux-degrade README · 3. 给压缩指令追加两节保真要求：压缩摘要最大的风险不是「短」，是「丢」。摘要生成器在压力下会优先保留叙述、丢掉硬事实：路径、命令、错误码、约束。

只要这次调用的 `purpose === 'compaction'`，插件就往压缩指令末尾追加两节：

```markdown
section: 3. 给压缩指令追加两节保真要求

text:
dsh-aux-degrade README · Commands & outcomes (MUST keep verbatim)：```

**幂等**：指令里已经有这两节就不会重复追加。

dsh-aux-degrade README · 4. 压缩调用清空 `tools`：压缩摘要不需要调用任何工具。留着工具定义既占 prompt、又给了模型「顺手去调一次工具」的机会——那会让一次本该纯文本的摘要生成变成多轮往返。

对 `purpose === 'compaction'` 的调用，`tools` 被清空。可用 `config.noTools = false` 关掉。

dsh-aux-degrade README · 日志：只要第 2–4 件里任何一件动了手，就打一行：

```
[aux-degrade/context] maxTokens下界=1024 压缩去tools=true 补两节=true
```

dsh-aux-degrade README · 9. 官方补丁提醒：装好就弹一次，指到哪条、怎么打：本插件**必须**打的那条官方补丁（`pi-ai-max-tokens-floor`，改 `@earendil-works/pi-ai` 的 `dist/api/simple-options.js`），由**本插件自己**在界面上弹一次窗告诉你。

为什么它必须打：pi-ai 在上游会把 `max_tokens` 钳到 1，辅助调用（压缩摘要、会话标题）可能只吐一两个字就被截断 —— 摘要没覆盖到的部分真的从上下文里消失。本插件只能在插件层关掉高思考档位并抬起下界，**那个钳位它改不了**（第三方 dist、ESM 命名空间只读）。

- **补丁库**：<https://github.com/xiamubumu/dsh-patch-library>；

- **打完就不再弹**；「不再提醒」是永久的，而且**按补丁 id 记** —— 将来新增的补丁仍然会提醒。

text:
dsh-aux-degrade README · 配置：配置文件是 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`：

```yaml
- id: aux-degrade
  config:
    enabled: true
    purposes: []

dsh-aux-degrade README · 配置：| 键 | 类型 | 代码默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | **`false`** | 只控制第 1 件（降思考强度）。配了 `true` 才生效——本仓库的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里配的就是 `true` |
| `purposes` | string[] | `[]` → `['compaction', 'session-title', 'title']` | 按用途识别辅助调用 |
| `auxPlugins` | string[] | `[]` → `['dsh-prompt-enhance']` | 按来源插件识别辅助调用。传 `['__none__']` 可整体关掉这条判据 |
| `models` | string[] | `[]`（不限） | 只对指定模型生效 |
| `effort` | string | `'off'` | 降到的档位 |
| `noTools` | boolean | `true` | 压缩调用是否清空 `tools`（第 4 件） |

dsh-aux-degrade README · 配置：> ⚠️ **`enabled: false` 不等于「零副作用」。** 旧文档里是这么写的，不对。`enabled` 只拦得住第 1 件（降思考强度）；第 2–4 件（抬 `maxTokens` 下界、补两节保真要求、压缩清 `tools`）在代码里跑在任何 `enabled` 检查**之前**，只要满足了 `purpose` 条件就会执行。想让第 2 件停下来，用 `DSH_AUX_MAXTOKENS_FLOOR=0`；第 4 件用 `config.noTools = false`；第 3 件（补两节）没有单独的开关。

dsh-aux-degrade README · 为什么默认识别 `dsh-prompt-enhance`？：因为它发起调用时**不传 `purpose`**——上面三条判据里「按用途」这一条对它完全失效。没了这条 `auxPlugins` 判据，它的调用会一路继承高档位思考强度，输出预算被推理吃光，表现为大量 502 与半个响应。这条判据就是为它加的。

dsh-aux-degrade README · 共存实测：会不会和别的插件打架（2026-10-15 实测）：**本插件只挂 1 个服务端接缝**：`llm/stream`。它**不占任何客户端槽位**，是四个自研插件里重叠面最小的一个。

本机 44 个已装插件里，只有 **4 个**同样挂在这个接缝上（`dsh-context-reclaim`、`dsh-cost-meter`、`dsh-emoji`、`dsh-sidenote`），四者都是协作式的 —— **实测共存无冲突**。

重叠面天然窄的原因：它**只对辅助调用**（压缩摘要、会话标题）设 `reasoningEffort`，不碰主对话请求。

**已知会撞的情况**：只有当对方也在 `llm/stream` 上**整体重建**请求（而不是增量改字段）时才可能出现。

text:
dsh-aux-degrade README · 🔗 与 `dsh-context-reclaim`（上下文治理两件套）—— 请务必一起安装：`dsh-aux-degrade` 与 [`dsh-context-reclaim`](https://github.com/xiamubumu/dsh-context-reclaim) 是同一套「上下文治理」方案的两半。**强烈建议同时安装，这是本插件最重要的联动关系。**

**① 它们共享同一个路由口径。** 两个插件用同一个判据区分「主对话调用」与「辅助调用」：

```
tools.length > 0 ? 'main' : 'aux'
```

reclaim 用它给每请求打 `route=` 标签，aux-degrade 用它决定这次调用算不算辅助调用。口径一致，两个插件才不会一边省着、一边漏着。

> 有一个细节值得知道：两边的判据**不是逐字相同**。reclaim 看的是 `tools` 数组有没有内容；aux-degrade 在「按形状」那条判据上还额外要求 `purpose === undefined`，为的是不误伤那些显式声明了用途的主对话调用。所以「被降级的调用」是「aux 路由」的一个子集——**降级比路由更保守**，这是有意的。
section: 🔗 与 `dsh-context-reclaim`（上下文治理两件套）—— 请务必一起安装

text:
dsh-aux-degrade README · 🔗 与 `dsh-context-reclaim`（上下文治理两件套）—— 请务必一起安装：**② 它们的分工。** aux-degrade 管**调用**（这次调用花多少思考预算、输出下界是多少、压缩指令要不要补保真要求）；reclaim 管**内容**（工具结果进历史前的净化与有界化、工具定义面折叠、前缀稳定化）。

**③ 缺了对方会怎样。**

| 只装 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 只有 aux-degrade | 一切照常工作。辅助调用省下了、压缩摘要不会被截断。但工具结果不会被净化与有界化，长结果原样进历史 |
| 只有 reclaim | 一切照常工作。但辅助调用仍会烧满思考预算、压缩摘要仍可能被静默截断——reclaim 只会在日志里打 `[reclaim/summary-audit] ⚠️ 摘要缺 N/8 段` 提醒你，**它自己不会去改摘要** |

**④ 两者互不依赖。** aux-degrade 只 import 官方的 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`，不 import reclaim，也不探测它装没装。**任何一个都能单独安装并正常工作**——这也是为什么它们是两个仓库而不是一个。

dsh-aux-degrade README · FAQ：
它会把主对话的思考强度也降下来吗？ 不会。判据全部指向「辅助调用」：要么用途在名单里，要么来源插件在名单里，要么这次调用连 `purpose` 都没声明且没有工具。主对话调用三样都不沾。而且**如果调用方自己显式设了 `reasoningEffort`，本插件一律放行**——不覆盖任何人的明确意图。
`enabled: false` 能完全关掉它吗？ 不能。`enabled` 只控制第 1 件（降思考强度）。第 2–4 件在任何配置下都会执行。这不是 bug——那三件修的是「上游插件省略了必填信息」这类问题，关掉它们会让上游继续出问题。真想逐项关：`DSH_AUX_MAXTOKENS_FLOOR=0` 关第 2 件，`noTools: false` 关第 4 件，第 3 件没有单独开关。

dsh-aux-degrade README · FAQ：
为什么默认就认 `dsh-prompt-enhance`？ 因为它发起调用时不传 `purpose`，只靠用途判据识别不到它。而它又恰好是受这个问题影响最重的插件——不识别的话它会继承高档位思考强度，输出预算被推理吃光，表现为大量 502 和半个响应。
装完要重启吗？ 要。宿主侧插件在 DSH 启动时装载。
支持网页版 DSH 吗？ 支持。本插件只挂 Cordis 的 `llm/stream` 瀑布接缝，不依赖任何 Electron 或桌面专属能力。**只要是 DSH，桌面版和网页版都能用。**
